title: OpenAI quietly launches paid quota reset feature for ChatGPT Plus, 8 dollars can immediately restore usage quota

content_html:
ChatGPT Plus has introduced new changes. Recently, some users' accounts have quietly launched a new paid reset quota feature.

According to feedback on social platforms, when the weekly quota is exhausted, a paid reset option will pop up on the interface. If users pay $8, they can immediately restore 100% of their usage quota, avoiding the original waiting time of about 5 hours. Of course, users can also choose not to pay and wait for the quota to be restored automatically at the end of the rolling cycle.

An OpenAI spokesperson said that this move aims to explore allowing some users who reach their usage limits to purchase additional quotas, making the product more convenient and practical. For heavy users who use it frequently, this option can significantly improve efficiency and reduce waiting costs.

In today's AI market, major manufacturers are using various strategies to attract and retain users. Previously, OpenAI and its competitor Anthropic have repeatedly launched promotional quotas or limited expansions to encourage users to integrate the tools into their daily workflows and establish long-term usage habits. As companies continue to expand their product ecosystems, they will continue to innovate in service and functional flexibility in the future.

content_html_zh:
ChatGPT Plus 引入了新的变化。 近日，部分用户账户悄然上线了新的付费重置额度功能。

据社交平台反馈，当周额度用完后，界面上会弹出付费重置选项。 如果用户支付8美元，就可以立即恢复100%的使用额度，避免了原来约5小时的等待时间。 当然，用户也可以选择不付费，等待滚动周期结束时配额自动恢复。

OpenAI发言人表示，此举旨在探索允许部分达到使用限额的用户购买额外配额，让产品更加便捷实用。 对于经常使用的重度用户来说，此选项可以显着提高效率并减少等待成本。

在当今的AI市场上，各大厂商都在使用各种策略来吸引和留住用户。 此前，OpenAI及其竞争对手Anthropic曾多次推出促销额度或有限扩展，以鼓励用户将工具融入日常工作流程并建立长期使用习惯。 随着企业不断扩大产品生态系统，未来将在服务和功能灵活性方面不断创新。
